main.description: Get the authenticated user's personal ebook library.

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match against title or authors. Mirrors the OPDS search feed.

sort.description: Result ordering. `recent` is newest-added first (the default, matching the library page and the OPDS /all feed); `title` and `author` are ascending alphabetical, matching the OPDS search results feed. Not switched implicitly when `q` is set — pass it explicitly.

total.description: Total number of books matching the query, across all pages

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page

storage.description: This user's storage usage against their quota

usedBytes.description: Total bytes currently stored for this user

quotaBytes.description: Total bytes this user is allowed to store

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the file content, used as stable identifier

format.description: File format (e.g. epub, pdf, mobi, fb2, cbz)

coverUrl.description: URL of the book cover image. When it points at the public catalog image proxy it needs no authentication; the `/library/covers/...` form is session-authenticated, so a client using service auth should use `hasLocalCover` and getPersonalBookCover instead.

hasLocalCover.description: Whether a cover extracted from the uploaded file is stored. Fetch it with getPersonalBookCover, which works under any supported authentication.

filename.description: Original uploaded file name. A sync client needs this to correlate the book with what is on the device.

description.description: Synopsis from the linked BookHive catalog entry

createdAt.description: When the book was added to the library

updatedAt.description: When the book record was last updated

progress.description: E-reader reading progress, when this book has been synced

shelfIds.description: IDs of the personal shelves this book belongs to

percentage.description: Reading progress as a fraction between 0 and 1

device.description: Name of the device that last reported progress
